scope: Static HSIC1.7 scalar conversion and shared PA protocol; native integration pending

shared_hal.classification: Shared ABI; not an exact Uke product build
shared_hal.transfer: Copy hue_adj/sat_adj/val_adj/cont_adj into corresponding UAPI fields under enable flags

retained_oem_binary.provenance: Third-party-retained proprietary binary; no redistribution permission inferred
retained_oem_binary.inspection: Static ELF instructions, Android APS2 relocations and constructor constants only; no execution or emulation
retained_oem_binary.table_entry: pa_sub_block_config_ at0x70008: enable0xf0, SDE mode0xf000, relocated ComputeGlobalPAParams pointer at0x70010

hue.conversion: Clamp integer input, multiply768, signed divide180 toward zero, mask12 bits

saturation.conversion: Single-precision clamp, multiply65/divide1, truncate signed toward zero, mask8 bits

value.conversion: Single-precision clamp, multiply65/divide255, truncate signed toward zero, mask8 bits

contrast.conversion: Single-precision clamp, multiply65/divide1, truncate signed toward zero, mask8 bits

saturation_threshold.conversion: Single-precision clamp, multiply255/divide1, truncate, mask8 bits and shift8

retained_oem_binary.packed_saturation: Low8 signed saturation code OR high8 threshold code; initialize a fresh output word
retained_oem_binary.limit: These are generic protocol ranges/scales, not preset settings or calibration coefficients; SixZone percent scaling and generic rounded fixed-point helpers are different operations
